name: Mushroom, Onion & Mozzarella Frittata with Lemony Arugula

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg cremini mushrooms
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Peel and small dice onions; peel and mince garlic. Transfer both to a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add onion and garlic to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes. Reserve bowl for later.
Increase heat to medium-high and add mushrooms; season with salt and thyme. Cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms are softened and liquid has evaporated, about 10-12 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp thyme

instructions.primary_message: Combine eggs, half the cheese, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
18 eggs
¾ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high.

Spread the mushrooms evenly in the skillet. Reduce heat to medium-low and pour in the egg mixture. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but the top is still runny, 5-7 minutes.
Sprinkle remaining cheese over the frittata. Place skillet in the oven until the top is set, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice the lemons into a large salad bowl. Add oil, maple syrup, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing. Add arugula and toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, cut frittata into wedges and place on plates; top with arugula and enjoy!
